_how_to_use: Each item links to `url`. When you are accepted into a partner program, paste your tracking link into `affiliate_url`: the page then uses it, adds a 'Partner link' label and rel=sponsored. `program` is a private note for you and is never shown on the site.

categories.title: Visa, Blue Card & recognition
categories.intro: Official sources first. Rules change every year, so always check here before you sign.

items.name: Make it in Germany
items.desc: The federal government's portal for skilled workers: visa types, Blue Card, Quick-Check.

items.name: Federal Foreign Office — Visa
items.desc: Visa requirements and how to apply at a German embassy or consulate.

items.name: Anerkennung in Deutschland
items.desc: Find out whether and how your foreign degree or vocational qualification is recognised.

items.name: anabin
items.desc: Database to check whether your university and degree are recognised (often needed for the Blue Card).

categories.title: Bank account & money transfer
categories.intro: You need a German (or SEPA) account for your salary. Online banks can be opened from abroad in minutes.

items.name: Wise
items.desc: Multi-currency account and cheap transfers home. Gives you an EUR IBAN quickly.
items.program: Wise affiliate program via Partnerize — CPA from £10 per new personal customer, 1-year cookie. Apply at wise.com affiliates.

items.name: N26
items.desc: German online bank with an English app. Account opening by video ident.
items.program: N26 affiliate via impact.com — email affiliate@n26.com for a personal offer.

categories.title: Health insurance & other insurance
categories.intro: Health insurance is mandatory in Germany. Most employees join a public insurer; high earners and freelancers can choose private.

items.name: Feather
items.desc: English-language insurance for expats: public & private health, liability, household and more.
items.program: Feather affiliate program (own dashboard, tiered commission per active policy). Apply at feather-insurance.com/become-a-partner.

items.name: Fintiba
items.desc: Blocked account + health insurance bundles, mainly for students and visa applicants.
items.program: Partner programme aimed at universities/agencies — ask whether websites qualify.

items.name: Expatrio
items.desc: Blocked account and health insurance packages for visa applicants.
items.program: Ambassador program is for (former) customers: €10 blocked account, €20–50 health insurance per referral.

categories.title: Learn German
categories.intro: Even for English-speaking jobs, B1 German makes daily life (and the next job search) much easier.

items.name: DW Learn German
items.desc: Free courses from A1 to C1 by Deutsche Welle, with placement test.

items.name: Goethe-Institut
items.desc: Courses and the officially recognised Goethe certificates (A1–C2).

items.name: Lingoda
items.desc: Live online German classes with native teachers, flexible schedule.
items.program: Affiliate via Everflow — footer marked 'Closed' at last check; email affiliate@lingoda.com.

categories.title: Salary & tax
categories.intro: German salaries are quoted gross per year. Check what lands in your account before you negotiate.

items.name: BMF tax calculator
items.desc: The Federal Ministry of Finance's official wage-tax calculator.

items.name: Entgeltatlas (Federal Employment Agency)
items.desc: Official median salaries by job, region, age and gender. Great for negotiation.

categories.title: Housing
categories.intro: Finding a flat is often harder than finding the job. Start with a furnished place, then search locally.

items.name: Wunderflats
items.desc: Furnished flats for 1+ months, bookable from abroad. Ask the landlord for the Wohnungsgeberbestätigung (needed for Anmeldung).

items.name: WG-Gesucht
items.desc: The biggest site for shared flats and rooms. Mostly German, but usable in English.

categories.title: More official job sources
categories.intro: Public job databases worth checking alongside this site.

items.name: Bundesagentur für Arbeit — Jobsuche
items.desc: Germany's largest job database, run by the Federal Employment Agency.

items.name: EURES
items.desc: The EU's job mobility portal, with jobs across Europe.
